label: Coolify
description: Coolify team, project, environment and deployment metadata

operations.name: check_connection
operations.description: Verify the token's protected bound team; public health is not credential evidence.

operations.name: get_current_team
operations.description: Read the token-bound team's ID and name, excluding members, billing and security settings.

operations.name: list_projects
operations.description: Read a bounded current-team project inventory and return one local slice.

operations.name: get_project
operations.description: Verify current-team membership and project identity; return environment metadata without variables.

operations.name: create_project
operations.description: Create project name/description in the bound team, including Coolify's default production environment. No resources are deployed. Verify an independent GET; do not retry an ambiguous write.

operations.name: update_project
operations.description: PATCH only supplied name/description. Provider returns 201 for an update; verify an independent GET. No resource changes.

operations.name: list_environments
operations.description: Read environment UUIDs under the selected current-team project.

operations.name: get_environment
operations.description: GET the documented project/UUID route. Validate numeric project parent and discard nested configuration and secrets.

operations.name: create_environment
operations.description: Create an empty named environment under the selected project. Does not create variables or resources. Verify by UUID and project ID; a duplicate name returns 409.

operations.name: update_environment
operations.description: PATCH only supplied name/description. Retain stable UUID through rename; verify independent parent-bound GET. No environment-variable changes.

operations.name: list_applications
operations.description: Read the current-team application inventory, validate each environment ID, and return only this environment's metadata.

operations.name: get_application
operations.description: Read identity/status and verify the exact environment; discard commands, Compose, credentials, network URLs and settings.

operations.name: list_services
operations.description: Read the team service inventory and return only this environment's identity metadata, excluding Compose and nested credentials.

operations.name: get_service
operations.description: Validate service environment and return ID/name/timestamps without nested applications, databases or secrets.

operations.name: list_deployments
operations.description: One provider skip/take history page for the exact application. Return status/IDs/timestamps without logs, snapshots or server URLs.

operations.name: get_deployment
operations.description: Read a deployment and verify its numeric application parent; does not start, cancel or change it.
